alpha.title: Editor, statistics and Refuge polish
changes: Smoother rich text editor, Markdown preview and voice note recording.
Statistics with an emotional spectrum chart and new cards.
Refined Refuge rituals: Echo Letters, Kintsugi and breathing.
More stable backup encryption.
Translations updated in all 10 languages.

alpha.title: New foundations
changes: The app's internals were rebuilt to share logic with the upcoming desktop version.
Database updated to version 18, with support for beacons and rites.
Notifications, audio player and backups reorganized.

alpha.title: Safer encrypted database
changes: A safety snapshot is taken before opening the database, with automatic recovery if the file goes missing or empty.
The app no longer deletes the database after an opening or key error.
Older encryption keys are detected and migrated automatically.

alpha.title: Ten languages, widgets and the Refuge
changes: The app is available in 10 languages, widgets included.
Refreshed home screen widgets for mood and daily phrase.
The Refuge: cathartic writing, Zen canvas and breathing exercises.
Backups include images, with compression.
Local Wi-Fi sync between devices, groundwork for the desktop version.

alpha.title: Modular foundations
changes: Published in three builds on the same day (26081115, 26081118 and 260811225).
The app was split into separate modules for its core and the home screen widgets, to make it easier to maintain.

alpha.title: Third alpha patch
changes: Support reports: encrypted diagnostic logs to help solve issues quickly.
Image viewer: tap a memory's image to see it full screen in high quality.
Fixed duplicated layouts and restored images in the detail view.
Automated version numbers and optimized app resources.
Fixed rules that could make the app crash at startup.

alpha.title: Second alpha
changes: PDF export: turn your memories into a custom Light Novel–style PDF.
Gradient creator: create and save gradients with smart text contrast.
Search upgraded to FTS5: it now ignores accents.
Editor: write and preview memories with Markdown.
Encryption and security optimizations.

alpha.title: First alpha on Google Play
changes: First version published on Google Play, as a closed alpha.
Memories can hold a photo, compressed and stored only on your device.
New fields to record the mood, emotions and anchors of each memory.
Backups now include photos and the new memory details.
Background maintenance keeps the local database compact.

alpha.title: Hours Lived arrives on Linux
changes: Download it as a .deb (Ubuntu, Debian, Linux Mint, Pop!_OS…), as an AppImage for any modern distribution, or as a Flatpak. Tested on a real GNOME desktop.
Your diary opens without typing anything: its key is kept in your desktop keyring. A master password is still optional.
Reminders use your desktop notifications, and choosing folders uses your desktop’s own window.
Also on Windows: texts in French and Italian no longer show stray backslashes, and lock screen errors appear in your language.
Importing a backup made with another birth date no longer changes yours, and travelling west no longer moves your dates by a day.

alpha.title: Hours Lived arrives on Windows
changes: Your diary on the computer: the same refuge as on your phone, with menus, keyboard shortcuts and a window that remembers its size.
Everything stays on your computer, encrypted. You can lock it with a master password and create a recovery key in case you forget it.
Encrypted backups that open on your phone and vice versa, plus automatic backups every 3 days.
Sync with your phone over your home Wi‑Fi, with no internet and no cloud.
It can stay in the system tray for your reminders, and it slows down when your computer needs the power: on battery, under heavy load or while another app is full screen.
Installer for Windows 10 and 11: updating or uninstalling keeps your memories unless you choose to delete them.
Available in 10 languages. The Linux version is still in development.
